youtube.title: Real Animal Sounds with Quackers! (QUACK!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🐮 QUACK! Quackers the duck quacked so loud that all the animal friends ran away! Can you help bring them back?

Hear the REAL sounds of 6 animals with Quackers: the cow, the dog, the frog, the sheep, the cat and the horse! Each friend comes back one by one in its own home (the farm, the park, the pond and more), and you hear the sound it really makes. Then sing along, and stay till the end, because someone is still awake late at night! 🌙

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn 6 animal names: cow, dog, frog, sheep, cat and horse
✔️ Hear the real sound each animal makes
✔️ See where animals live: farm, park, pond and forest
✔️ Sing an animal sounds song with Quackers!
